name: Koura Fine Diamond Jewelry Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2022, Koura Fine Diamond Jewelry Ltd is in the business of Gold and Diamond jewelry[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
KFDJL is in the business of manufacturing and designing of Gold & Diamond Jewellery.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.13 times its book value
Promoter holding has increased by 2.68% over last quarter.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 78.1 days to 36.1 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.30 Cr.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
